SQL_DOC.V_SQL: SELECT CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND, PROCE_STATE_CD FROM KEPMPRQ02 WHERE CSTMR_ID IN ('KRKOLO0035C001','KRKOLO0037C001') AND SND_CHK = 'N' AND PROCE_STATE_CD IN ('RE04','RE05 ','RE06 ') ORDER BY CSTMR_ID, QUOTA_RE_NO, QUOTA_RE_SEQ, QUOTA_RE_RND
SQL_DOC.P_SQL:
SELECT SUBSTR(RQ02.CSTMR_ID,1,10) AS BUYER , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_NO AS QUOTATION_NO , RQ02.IF_QUOTA_RE_SEQ AS QUOTATION_SEQ , RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND AS REVISION , TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') AS QUOTATION_DATE , RQ02.GDS_CD AS BUYER_ITEM_NO , RQ02.GDS_NM||'/'||RQ02.STND_NM AS DESCRIPTION , RQ02.UNIT_CD AS UNIT_MEASURE , RQ02.MNFATRE_NM AS MAKER_NAME , substr(CA09.SPPLR_ID,1,10) AS SUPPLIER , GETALANCINFO(CA09.SPPLR_ID,'BIZ_NM') AS SELLER_NAME , (SELECT USR_NM FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE CA09.SPPLR_ID = ALANC_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SUPPLIER_PERSON_NAME , (SELECT PHON_NO FROM KEPCOUR01 WHERE CA09.SPPLR_ID = ALANC_ID AND USE_CHK = 'Y' AND ROWNUM = 1) AS SUPPLIER_TELNO , RQ02.TRGT_UNTPRC AS UNIT_PRICE , CA09.SLS_UNTPRC AS QUOTATION_PRICE , RQ02.QUOTA_CREAT_DATE AS ADD_DATE , RQ02.RELIER_ID AS REQ_USER_ID , RQ02.RELIER_NM AS REQ_USER_NAME , RQ02.RE_DEPT_CD AS REQ_USER_DEPT_CODE , RQ02.RE_DEPT_NM AS REQ_USER_DEPT_NAME , RQ02.PHON_NO AS REQ_USER_TEL , RQ02.EMAIL_ADDR AS REQ_USER_MAIL , RQ02.FRCST_ORDR_DATE AS CLOSE_DATE , RQ02.QTY AS ITEM_QTY , '' AS REMARK FROM KEPMPRQ02 RQ02, KEPMDCA09 CA09 WHERE RQ02.CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND RQ02.QUOTA_RE_RND= $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$ AND RQ02.SND_CHK = 'N' AND RQ02.CSTMR_ID = CA09.CSTMR_ID AND RQ02.GDS_CD = CA09.GDS_CD AND CA09.USE_CHK = 'Y' AND TO_CHAR(SYSDATE,'YYYYMMDD') BETWEEN CA09.UNTPRC_EFCTV_STRT_DATE AND CA09.UNTPRC_EFCTV_FNSH_DATE
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'Y', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND= $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
UPDATE KEPMPRQ02 SET SND_CHK = 'E', SND_DATM = SYSDATE WHERE CSTMR_ID = '$G_RS.CSTMR_ID$' AND QUOTA_RE_NO = '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_NO$' AND QUOTA_RE_SEQ= '$G_RS.QUOTA_RE_SEQ$' AND QUOTA_RE_RND= $G_RS.QUOTA_RE_RND$
